name: Strike-through and subtext
what: Three centred lines of text settle into place; a marker line then opens from the middle of the first line and strikes it out, and a short subtext types itself in above it; the third line is struck out the same way with its own subtext typed below it, while the middle line stays untouched.
origin: MotionLab's own build in the Editorial warm look (2026-10)
motion: f0-f14 the three lines hold 20 % larger; f15-f25 they settle to their size (fast S-curve, cubic-bezier(0.7, 0.138, 0.17, 0.755)); f53-f66 a marker line opens from the middle of line 1 outwards (slow start, long tail, cubic-bezier(0.485, 0.048, 0.076, 0.971)); f66-f68 a cursor fades in above-right and subtext 1 types f69-f81 (the cursor blinks once, gone at f82); f114-f127 the same marker line on line 3; f123-f139 subtext 2 types below it; then it holds to f194

tracks.name: lines settle
tracks.what: the block of three lines shrinks from 120 % to its real size

tracks.name: strike line 1
tracks.what: a marker line opens from the middle of line 1 outwards

tracks.name: subtext 1 typed
tracks.what: a cursor fades in and subtext 1 types in letter by letter

tracks.name: strike line 3
tracks.what: the same marker line on line 3

tracks.name: subtext 2 typed
tracks.what: a cursor fades in and subtext 2 types in below line 3
